scope: Repair local device telemetry persistence and test concurrent synthetic reads/writes. No training, scored EXP, final access or publishing.
question: Can a bounded retry of Windows atomic replacement survive transient reader contention while persistent errors, STOP and supervisor deadlines remain fatal?
budget_origin: Agent execution bound for this one authorized deliverable, not a reset of historical service allowances.

retry_policy.persistent_failure: raise, preserve old complete telemetry, no success envelope
retry_policy.time_accounting: All waiting remains inside existing worker/fit clocks

tests: Reproduce legacy atomic_write_json denial with an actual Windows handle lacking delete sharing; preserve exception code.
Actual transient reader handle release permits replacement before 1-second retry deadline.
Persistent handle denial fails at deadline, never reports success, preserves valid previous JSON.
Non-Windows/nonsharing I/O errors fail immediately; deterministic fake-clock tests include STOP and PAUSE during retry.
Three independent synthetic stress runs, 2000 writes each, concurrent reader validates JSON and monotonic coherent counters; at most 30 seconds per run.
Real subprocess supervision retains STOP, fit/worker timeout and CUDA-limit detection; persistent telemetry failure remains a failed worker.
Full regression and immutable history/prefix validation after repair; no corpus or model fit in new repair tests.
source_scope: New PC-01-only telemetry helper and worker call site, tests, maintenance status/docs/certification. Do not alter shared atomic_write_json, model, data, training recipe, thresholds or historical artifacts.
auxiliary_history_check: New versioned validator distinguishes append-only ledger prefixes from completed files; original validators and failure annotation retained.

outcomes.pass: Keep repair in maintenance, report verification and request decision before another dev attempt.
outcomes.fail: Preserve diagnostics, stop with exact blocker; no hidden retry of the model.
